# VisualSemanticDecoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that uses spiking neural networks to decode visual semantic information from fMRI brain activity patterns. Enables brain-computer interfaces and neuromorphic systems to directly interpret high-level visual concepts from neural signals.
